title: Braun's bound for more pigeons, and bit-colouring through a proper colouring
claim: Against Braun's formal development at commit 8904bf09 of https://github.com/kbr-/math-research (replayed in BPHP-RES-PARITY-AUDIT-20261019-001A, definitions audited in -001B): (1) for every l >= 32 and every m with 2^l+1 <= m and 8192 m l^2 (2l+5) <= 4^l, every refutation of the usual bit pigeonhole clause set with m pigeons and 2^l holes, in the audited proof system, has more than exp(4^l/(8192 m l^2)) lines; (2) for every graph G on v vertices and every map f from its vertices to m classes that gives adjacent vertices different classes, every refutation of the bit encoding of 2^l-colouring G maps line by line to a refutation of the bit pigeonhole clause set with m pigeons, so the bound of (1) holds for G whenever m is in that range; (3) witnesses against vacuity: the range of m is nonempty at l = 32, the clause sets are unsatisfiable when m > 2^l or G has no 2^l-colouring, and the bit-colouring clause set of the complete graph on m vertices is the bit pigeonhole clause set with m pigeons.
failure_conditions: The checkout is not the pinned commit, has tracked changes, or a file the proof relies on differs from its recorded digest.
The Lean file fails to compile against the replayed build, or a stated theorem depends on an axiom other than propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
A control that alters a statement (a larger exponent, a dropped properness hypothesis, too few pigeons for unsatisfiability) is accepted by the kernel.
The bit-colouring clause set does not express the colouring problem: it is satisfiable for a graph with no 2^l-colouring, or differs from bit PHP on the complete graph.
foundation_claim_scope: Proof complexity of the bit pigeonhole principle and bit-encoded graph colouring in Res(⊕); no contact-first claim.

validation.status: checked: eight theorems compiled against the replayed build with standard axioms; four controls rejected, the constant control exactly at the calibration step; relied-on sources bound by digest; no human or external review
validation.level: V2 trusted kernel (Lean 4.34.0-rc2 with the pinned Mathlib) against the author's definitions and lemmas, whose replay is BPHP-RES-PARITY-AUDIT-20261019-001A-E001 and whose definitional fidelity is BPHP-RES-PARITY-AUDIT-20261019-001B-P001.
validation.novelty: corollary level: a recalibration of the last step of Braun's proof (arXiv:2609.23015) with the number of pigeons kept general, plus the standard substitution along a proper colouring; neither is stated in the preprint, and a brief search found no earlier DAG-like Res(⊕) size bound for weak bit-PHP or for bit-colouring beyond complete graphs (Efremenko, Garlík and Itsykson give tree-like size and DAG-like width bounds for weak bit-PHP).
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-19; checked by the Lean kernel against the author's development, which this proof does not modify.
